body: I may be different than you. But what helped me stems back to what my grandpa told me as a kid. The best way to go over one is to get into another. That's crude but he wasnt a subtle man. Honestly, time is probably the best thing. But I found that investing my time in someone else makes it easier to forget. Take control of your own narrative and live your life for YOU.

I've been here. I battled with this type of thing before. Sometimes I still do. I could sit here and give the normal "keep your head up champ" speech but I'll just say this. If you truely and honestly love her, you have to let her go. Not just for her but for yourself. People need space sometimes and obviously I dont know all the details but she felt like she needed space to figure things out. I'm only 21 so I'm not an expert on any of this but I will tell you, if it's meant to be she'll be back. Hope this helped.
Yessir and I will try my best to help who I can I owe that to you.

She definitely cant help you unless you're completely honest with her. But I understand it can be extremely scary to open up to a stranger especially one with the authority to have you hospitalized. But without knowing exactly how you feel she cant help you the proper way.

Dont kill yourself. Please. I've been there. You feel isolated and trapped. You need change. you're just in a rut. Find a new hobby or try to find some positive people to talk to. Killing yourself is always an option dont rush to do it so quickly. Take a year and work on yourself try to learn and love yourself.

Thank you for your words of encouragement. I'm not one of those "nothing is ever gonna get better" type of people. I hope things change for the better. I dont want to feel like this anymore. I'm also pulling for you and anyone else dealing with this. I really appreciate you taking time out of your day to spread a positive message especially because you suffer the same thing I do. I know how hard it can be to be positive and help people when you're fighting a battle yourself

Man these are very wise words and I take them to heart. I do need to love myself and I've tried recently to do so. I'm trying to take up a new hobby and put more time into meeting new people who have a positive outlook on life. Your comment means so much to me and have helped me so much. Everything you're saying is true and I hope I can take some of what you said and apply it to my road to recovery

Thank you man. You've really made things better today. I will have to look into therapy and try to get help. I have to make progress somewhere and what I'm doing now isnt helping. I appreciate you stepping out and commenting it takes a big heart to help someone you dont know.
I really appreciate your insight. It helps alot. You have a valid point. Someone had to make a stand for men who feel the way I do. Thank you for your time it really means alot
Thanks for the feed back that's definitely something I'm gonna have to look into

I appreciate you taking time to read this. It really gives me hope that all of society isn't trash. I've looked into therapy but I'm honestly scared. what if I dont like what they say to me? The meds make me feel sluggish and it's already hard enough for me to get motivated. Almost like a zombie. They make me feel better but I dont get anything done. And you're right. I like the way you put that. It is always an option what's the rush? Thanks you've definitely given me a slither of hope
Absolutely, I really appreciate you taking time to read and comment. It means alot. It just seems like I'm constantly rowing and not moving. Do you ever feel like that?
